Freestyle Studio 1.4.3 labels the script's read time.
- **Clear read time.** The Script tab now shows Words and Est. time on separate rows, with a short line under the time that splits it into speaking and pauses at your current pace.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.2 keeps your Google sign-in in the Workspace form.
- **Sign in once.** Settings > Workspaces now remembers the Google account you signed in with, even after you close Settings or restart the app.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.1 makes adding a Workspace easier.
- **SOP folder is optional.** Settings > Workspaces now needs only a name and a Google account. You can add the SOP folder later.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.0 makes the Studio sidebar simpler and the script editor more forgiving.
- **Sidebar tabs.** Studio settings are now split into Film, Video, Audio and Script. Film holds what changes from take to take: the script, format, platform, layout, Framer, font size and pace. - **Edit the script during a take.** Edit stays available while recording. It opens at the sentence you were reading, and saving returns you to the same spot. - **Return adds a line.** In the script editor, Return now starts a new line where your cursor is. - **Video IDs.** Give a script an ID such as VID-0042 from the title editor (the pencil on the title card). The ID shows on the title card and is saved with every take. - **Automation setting.** Settings > General has a new switch, off by default, that lets automation tools on your Mac control the recorder.
A take keeps the script snapshot it started with, even if you edit the script while recording.

Freestyle Studio now stays in the menu bar without a Dock icon, even while the recorder is open.
- Closing the idle recorder stops its screen, camera and microphone previews. - Reopen it from the menu bar to start previews again. - Open at Login keeps capture off until you open the recorder or start a recording. - Settings is available in the menu bar menu.
macOS still shows its capture indicator during live preview or recording. Stop and save an active take before closing the recorder.

# Freestyle Studio 1.3.4
- Freestyle Studio now stays in the menu bar. Closing the window hides it instead of quitting the app. - The Dock icon only shows while the window is open. Open the window again with **Show Freestyle Studio** in the menu bar. - Quit from the menu bar or with ⌘Q. - New **Open at Login** option in the menu bar menu starts the app in the menu bar when you log in. It is off unless you turn it on.
Requires macOS 14 or newer. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Google sign-in and Drive uploads are not included in team builds.

# Freestyle Studio 1.3.3
- Download and update through the new Freestyle Studio address. - Use Freestyle Studio names for recording folders and app storage. - Preserve existing recordings, saved settings and workspaces during the folder rename. If both old and new folders exist, keep data in place and explain the conflict. - Keep automatic updates working for earlier installations.
Requires macOS 14 or newer. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Google sign-in and Drive uploads are not included in team builds.

# Freestyle Studio 1.3.2
- Open the live HTML cards from the Cards menu, follow links, reveal the source file, or copy its path. - Import scripts and transcripts directly from the Files menu. - Keep your preferred script font, spacing, width and reading settings between launches. - Frame the screen and camera in Freestyle. Center the screen or trim browser tabs and toolbars with adjustable edges. - See levels for every microphone input and use the five-second speech check to set recording gain. System audio now defaults to full volume and remembers your adjustment.
Microphone gain remains under your control. Use **Set speech level…** with your normal speaking voice before recording.
